detect_place_point_by_pcd_method: detect a place point on a table in front of the Spot robot using point cloud and plane fitting heuristics
contrained_place_point_estimation: estimate a constrained place point relative to a detected object using spatial propositions like left or right
generate_point_cloud: generate an Open3D point cloud from an RGB image, depth image, and mask using camera intrinsics
filter_pointcloud_by_normals_in_the_give: filter a point cloud by selecting points whose normals align with a given direction vector
rank_planes: rank detected planes by proximity and point count to select the best candidate plane for interaction
